description:
Situated in the popular and well-established Derrygreenagh Park development, this well-maintained mid-terrace residence offers spacious and versatile accommodation in a convenient village setting.

The ground floor comprises a welcoming living/sitting room featuring a solid fuel stove, creating a warm and inviting focal point. The adjoining kitchen provides ample storage and workspace, while a family bathroom completes the main living accommodation. To the rear, a thoughtfully designed extension provides a generous ground floor bedroom overlooking the private rear garden, offering flexibility for a variety of family needs.

Upstairs, the property boasts three well-proportioned bedrooms, providing comfortable accommodation for growing families or those requiring additional space.

Externally, the rear garden benefits from a detached garage with valuable vehicular access via a rear laneway, making it ideal for secure parking, storage or a workshop. To the front, the property enjoys an attractive outlook over a large green area, enhancing the sense of space and providing a pleasant setting.

The property has been exceptionally well cared for over the years and is presented in good condition throughout, allowing its new owners to move in with ease.

Ideally located within walking distance of Rochfortbridge village, residents can enjoy a wide range of local amenities including primary and secondary schools, shops, a pharmacy, cafés and everyday services. The M6 motorway is less than 1km away, offering excellent connectivity to Dublin and Galway, while the thriving Midlands towns of Mullingar, Tullamore and Athlone are all within an easy commute.

This is an excellent opportunity to acquire a spacious family home in a convenient and highly accessible location, combining village living with outstanding transport links.
